status_semantics: status is a publication permission, not a grade of evidence. VERIFIED means the statement is cleared to appear in public copy; it never means a third party verified it. The grade of evidence is verification_class, and only verification_class third_party denotes independent evidence committed in-repo. No record carries it today.
verification_limitation: No claim in this file is third-party verified. Every public claim is self-attested by CONFENGE or the owner, or backed by an artifact this repository itself produces. self_attested_public (public specialist page and institutional copy already on confenge.com.br) and owner_declared (the owner's personal professional declaration, with no documentary backing in this repository) carry no external corroboration at all. data_backed_internal points to a committed dataset through evidence_ref, which makes the number reproducible here but still not independently audited. content_published and operational_declared are statements about work this site publishes or operations it runs. This circularity is a documented limitation, not an upgrade of proof class.

verification_classes.third_party: Independent third-party evidence committed in-repo. Unused: no record qualifies today.
verification_classes.data_backed_internal: Reproducible from a dataset committed in this repository. evidence_ref names the file and the field. Internal, not audited by a third party.
verification_classes.operational_declared: Operational fact declared by the business about how it operates.
verification_classes.content_published: Backed by technical content published on this site.
verification_classes.self_attested_public: Published on the owned specialist page and institutional copy. Circular by construction.
verification_classes.owner_declared: Personal declaration by the owner. No documentary backing in this repository. The weakest class: never present it as data-backed or as a client result.
